## Personality

Jane is a plain, steady, and sensible individual who approaches her endeavors with a plodding and conscientious nature. Dedicated to her career, her primary goal is to devote her entire life to teaching rather than marrying, drawn by the financial independence of earning a salary.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane became a member of Anne's newly established story club alongside other schoolmates, though she deliberately avoided romantic plots in her writing so she would not feel silly reading her work aloud. To further her education, she joined the preparation class for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations alongside her peers. Jane successfully passed the entrance exams, allowing her to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with the other students from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). During her time in town for her studies, she visited [Anne](../character/anne.md) at her boarding house to socialize and discuss their experiences.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jane.md)

Jane is a friend and classmate of [Anne](../character/anne.md), having grown up alongside her in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their connection developed further when Jane joined the story club started by [Anne](../character/anne.md) to cultivate their imaginations. They continue their close relationship through their shared school experiences, including moving on together to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

- Friend of — spending the midsummer afternoon together and playing  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), +2 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)
